name: tidy
description: Finds your finished sessions sitting idle in the desktop app (not running, no open PR, quiet for a day) and lists them in a pane with an Archive button each. /tidy opens it.

idleHours.title: Idle for (hours)
idleHours.description: A session counts as finished once it has had no activity for this long, is not running or pinned, and has no open pull request
